title: Practitioner Decision Flow
description: Interactive Mermaid decision tree of the five gates a security practitioner clears before acting on a live system: Legal, Ethical, Forensic, Notification, and Public Good. Hover any gate for what it checks.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

educational.topic: Legal, ethical, forensic, and disclosure obligations of practitioners
learningObjectives: Apply a five-gate checklist (Legal, Ethical, Forensic, Notification, Public Good) before acting on a system.
Explain why a legal action may still be unethical or forensically unsound.
Recognize when an event triggers a breach-notification duty or coordinated disclosure.
educational.prerequisites: Familiarity with the chapter sections on law, professional ethics, forensics, and breach notification.

pedagogical.assessment: Discussion questions in the lesson plan walk a scenario through all five gates.
misconceptionsAddressed: Assuming 'legal' is sufficient grounds to act.
Overlooking that notification clocks start at discovery, not at remediation.
